intro.text: The young daughter of Senior Trackt Ais and her husband, Mellis.
The young daughter of Senior Trackt Ais and her husband, Mellis, often called Melly.

items.text: Melloni knew her mother's work was dangerous and sometimes feared Ais would not come home. When Ais urged Mellis to take her south for safety, he kept her in Kezare.
Sharezan came to the house to kill Melloni and her father, but Kenton was there and threw him through a wall.

appearance.text: A girl of about seven with brown pigtails and tan skin, dressed in purple; she sleeps under a purple blanket with a teddy bear.
